# Нелинейные модели

## tvAR

```{r}
e <- rnorm(300, sd = .1)
x <- numeric(300)
tau <- (1:300)/300
beta <- 0.9 * cos(6 * tau)
for (t in 2:300) {
  x[t] <- beta[t] * x[t-1] + e[t]
}
```

```{r}
plot.ts(beta)
```

```{r}
plot.ts(x)
```

```{r}
pacf(x)
```

```{r}
arima(x, order = c(2, 0, 0), include.mean = FALSE)
```

```{r}
mod.tvAR <- tvReg::tvAR(x, p = 1, type = "none")
```

```{r}
plot(mod.tvAR$coefficients, type = "l")
lines(beta, col="red")
```

```{r}
summary(mod.tvAR)
```

```{r}
mod.tvAR$residuals**2 |> sum()
```

```{r}
arima(x, order = c(2, 0, 0), include.mean = FALSE)$residuals**2 |> sum()
```

## TAR

Модель задается в следующем виде: $$\begin{aligned}
y_{t+{steps}} &= \left(\phi_{1,0} + \sum_{i=0}^{mL - 1} \phi_{1,i} y_{t - d i}\right) \mathbb{I}(z_t \leqslant {th}) + \left(\phi_{2,0} + \sum_{i=0}^{mH - 1} \phi_{2,i} y_{t - d i}\right) \mathbb{I}(z_t \gt {th}) + \varepsilon_{t+{steps}} \\
z_t &= \begin{cases}
  y_{t - {thDelay} \times d} \\
  {mTh}_1 y_t + {mTh}_2 y_{t - d} + \dots + {mTh}_m y_{t - (m - 1)d} \\
  {thVar}_t
\end{cases}
\end{aligned}$$

```{r}
tsDyn::setarTest(
  sun,
  m = 11, thDelay = 0,
  nboot = 10,
  trim = 0.1,
  test = "1vs"
)
```

```{r}
mod.setar <- tsDyn::setar(sun, m = 11, thDelay = 0)
summary(mod.setar)
```

```{r}
mod.setar2 <- tsDyn::setar(sun, mL = 9, mH = 5, thDelay = 0)
summary(mod.setar2)
```

```{r}
plot(mod.setar)
```

```{r}
plot(mod.setar2)
```

```{r}
tsDyn::setarTest(l_lynx, m = 2, thDelay = 1)
```

```{r}
mod.setar <- tsDyn::setar(l_lynx, m = 2, thDelay = 1)
summary(mod.setar)
```

```{r}
plot(mod.setar)
```

```{r}
mod.setar <- tsDyn::setar(l_lynx, m = 2, thDelay = 1, th = 3.25)
summary(mod.setar)
```

```{r}
tsDyn::setarTest(apple_r, m = 10, thDelay = 0)
```

```{r}
mod.setar <- tsDyn::setar(apple_r, m = 10, thDelay = 0)
summary(mod.setar)
```

```{r}
plot(mod.setar)
```

## STAR

Модель задается в следующем виде: $$\begin{aligned}
y_{t+{steps}} &= \left(\phi_{1,0} + \sum_{i=1}^{mL - 1} \phi_{1,i} y_{t - d i}\right) G(z_t, \gamma, {th}) + \left(\phi_{2,0} + \sum_{i=1}^{mH - 1} \phi_{2,i} y_{t - d i}\right) [1 - G(z_t, \gamma, {th})] + \varepsilon_{t+{steps}} \\
z_t &= \begin{cases}
  y_{t - {thDelay} \times d} \\
  {mTh}_1 y_t + {mTh}_2 y_{t - d} + \dots + {mTh}_m y_{t - (m - 1)d} \\
  {thVar}_t
\end{cases}
\end{aligned}$$

Проведем тест для ряда `sun`:

```{r}
model <- dynlm::dynlm(sun ~ L(sun, 1:11) + L(sun^1, 2):L(sun, 1:11) + L(sun^2, 2):L(sun, 1:11) + L(sun^3, 2):L(sun, 1:11))
summary(model)
```

```{r}
hypotheses <- NULL
for (j in 1:3) for (i in 1:11) {
  hypotheses <- c(hypotheses, paste("L(sun, 1:11)", i, ":L(sun^", j, ", 2)=0", sep = ""))
}
```

```{r}
car::linearHypothesis(model, hypotheses)
```

```{r}
mod.lstar <- tsDyn::lstar(sun, m = 11, thDelay = 1)
summary(mod.lstar)
```

```{r}
mod.lstar <- tsDyn::lstar(sun, m = 11, thDelay = 1, starting.control = list(gammaInt = c(0.1, 40), nGamma = 100))
mod.lstar
```

```{r}
AIC(mod.lstar)
```

```{r}
plot(mod.lstar)
```

Проведем тест для ряда `l_lynx`:

```{r}
model <- dynlm::dynlm(l_lynx ~ L(l_lynx, 1:2) + L(l_lynx^1, 2):L(l_lynx, 1:2) + L(l_lynx^2, 2):L(l_lynx, 1:2) + L(l_lynx^3, 2):L(l_lynx, 1:2))
summary(model)
```

```{r}
hypotheses <- NULL
for (j in 1:3) for (i in 1:2) {
  hypotheses <- c(hypotheses, paste("L(l_lynx, 1:2)", i, ":L(l_lynx^", j, ", 2)=0", sep = ""))
}
```

```{r}
car::linearHypothesis(model, hypotheses)
```

```{r}
mod.lstar <- tsDyn::lstar(l_lynx, m = 2, mTh = c(0, 1), control=list(maxit=3000))
summary(mod.lstar)
```

```{r}
AIC(mod.lstar)
```

```{r}
plot(mod.lstar)
```

```{r}
mod.lstar <- tsDyn::lstar(l_lynx, m = 2, include = "none")
summary(mod.lstar)
```

```{r}
AIC(mod.lstar)
```

```{r}
.apple_r <- zoo(apple_r)
model <- dynlm::dynlm(.apple_r ~ L(.apple_r, 1:10) + L(.apple_r^1, 1):L(.apple_r, 1:10) + L(.apple_r^2, 1):L(.apple_r, 1:10) + L(.apple_r^3, 1):L(.apple_r, 1:10))
summary(model)
```

```{r}
hypotheses <- NULL
for (j in 1:3) for (i in 1:10) {
  hypotheses <- c(hypotheses, paste("L(.apple_r, 1:10)", i, ":L(.apple_r^", j, ", 1)=0", sep = ""))
}
```

```{r}
car::linearHypothesis(model, hypotheses)
```

```{r}
mod.lstar <- tsDyn::lstar(apple_r, m = 10, thDelay = 0)
mod.lstar
```

```{r}
mod.lstar <- tsDyn::lstar(apple_r, m = 10, starting.control = list(gammaInt = c(0.1, 40), nGamma = 100))
mod.lstar
```

```{r}
AIC(mod.lstar)
```

```{r}
plot(mod.lstar)
```
